toolDescription: Update My Monster Farm v.2 state, paths, traits, flags, counters, residents, economy, and daily ticks during natural RP.

toolActions.name: set_flag
toolActions.description: Set or clear a boolean gameplay/consent/quest/warning flag.

toolActions.name: adjust_counter
toolActions.description: Increment or set a counter.* or streak.* value.

toolActions.name: set_player_trait
toolActions.description: Grant or remove a modular player.trait:*.

params.name: enabled
params.description: True to grant, false to remove.

toolActions.name: set_player_state
toolActions.description: Update player.status:*, player.tf:*, player.craving:*, or player.body_variant.

toolActions.name: evaluate_gates
toolActions.description: Check whether all gate prerequisites are met for a path, stage, twist, PONR, or bad ending.

toolActions.name: set_active_path
toolActions.description: Activate or advance a species path, threat route, twist, PONR, or bad ending (enforces gates by default and applies Fx).

params.name: force
params.description: Override unmet gates if explicitly intended.

toolActions.name: manage_resident
toolActions.description: Add, update, remove, assign, bond, date, or care for a farm resident.

toolActions.name: economy_tx
toolActions.description: Execute a farm buy, sell (with Corvin Vale 5% fee), upgrade, or balance adjustment.

params.name: unit_price
params.description: Override unit price or upgrade cost.

toolActions.name: farm_action
toolActions.description: Perform farm policy, safeword, TF purification, quest, hunt, or containment actions.

params.name: target
params.description: Route, resident, species, or quest ID.

toolActions.name: end_day
toolActions.description: Advance one or more days, updating moon phase, feed consumption, recovery, and threat warning gates.

toolActions.name: feed_request
toolActions.description: Create a pending predation feed request that halts for explicit player confirmation.

toolActions.name: confirm_feed
toolActions.description: Confirm or cancel a pending predation feed request.

params.name: confirm
params.description: True to execute, false to cancel.

toolActions.name: get_status
toolActions.description: Retrieve detailed ledger, market, resident, or quest status.

- Named-resident predation (`/feed`) ALWAYS stops at a pending confirmation state until the player explicitly runs `/confirm feed` or `/cancel`.
- Regular species paths strictly respect mutual consent and `safeword`; Wild Threat routes have no safety net.

def _to_float(val, default=0.0):
    try:
        n = float(val)
        return n if math.isfinite(n) else default
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _to_int(val, default=0):
    return int(round(_to_float(val, float(default))))


def _clamp(val, lo=0, hi=100):
    return max(lo, min(hi, _to_int(val, lo)))


def _slug(raw):
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9_]+", "_", str(raw or "").strip().lower()).strip("_")

def ensure_state_shape(raw):
    base = init_state({})
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        return base
    for k in (
        "day", "season", "weather", "moon_phase", "policy",
        "funds", "debt", "compost", "parts", "pending_feed",
        "triggered_twists", "unlocked_ponrs", "bad_endings", "last_ledger_note",
    ):
        if k in raw:
            base[k] = raw[k]
    for dict_key in (
        "food", "products", "items", "upgrades", "habitats",
        "reputation", "herd", "ecology", "farm", "residents",
        "active_threats", "flags", "counters", "streaks",
    ):
        if isinstance(raw.get(dict_key), dict):
            if dict_key in ("food", "reputation", "herd", "ecology", "farm", "habitats"):
                merged = dict(base[dict_key])
                merged.update(raw[dict_key])
                base[dict_key] = merged
            else:
                base[dict_key] = dict(raw[dict_key])
    if isinstance(raw.get("player"), dict):
        pl = dict(base["player"])
        for pk in ("traits", "statuses", "tf", "cravings", "day_counters"):
            if isinstance(raw["player"].get(pk), dict):
                pl[pk] = dict(raw["player"][pk])
        if "body_variant" in raw["player"]:
            pl["body_variant"] = str(raw["player"]["body_variant"] or "male")
        if "days_captive" in raw["player"]:
            pl["days_captive"] = _to_int(raw["player"]["days_captive"], 0)
        base["player"] = pl
    if isinstance(raw.get("quests"), list):
        base["quests"] = list(raw["quests"])
    base["day"] = max(1, _to_int(base["day"], 1))
    base["funds"] = max(0, _to_int(base["funds"], 120))
    base["debt"] = max(0, _to_int(base["debt"], 0))
    return base


def _debt_tier(debt):
    if debt >= 400:
        return "BANKRUPTCY CRISIS (>=400g)"
    if debt >= 250:
        return "FORCED CHOICE (>=250g)"
    if debt >= 100:
        return "DEBT WARNING (>=100g)"
    return ""


def _find_resident(state, query):
    q = _slug(query)
    if not q:
        return None
    if q in state["residents"]:
        return state["residents"][q]
    for res in state["residents"].values():
        if _slug(res.get("name")) == q or _canon_species(res.get("species")) == _canon_species(query):
            return res
    return None


def _recompute_herd(state):
    res_list = list(state["residents"].values())
    if not res_list:
        return
    n = len(res_list)
    state["herd"]["trust"] = _clamp(sum(_to_float(r.get("trust"), 30) for r in res_list) / n)
    state["herd"]["morale"] = _clamp(sum(_to_float(r.get("morale"), 50) for r in res_list) / n)
    state["herd"]["fatigue"] = _clamp(sum(_to_float(r.get("fatigue"), 12) for r in res_list) / n)


def _resolve_var(state, expr, resident=None):
    token = expr.strip()
    if token.startswith("flag:"):
        return bool(state["flags"].get(token[5:], False))
    if token.startswith("player.trait:"):
        return bool(state["player"]["traits"].get(token[13:], False))
    if token.startswith("player.status:"):
        return bool(state["player"]["statuses"].get(token[14:], False))
    if token.startswith("player.tf:"):
        return _to_int(state["player"]["tf"].get(token[10:], 0), 0)
    if token.startswith("player.craving:"):
        return _to_int(state["player"]["cravings"].get(token[15:], 0), 0)
    if token == "player.body_variant":
        return state["player"].get("body_variant", "male")
    if token.startswith("player.body_variant."):
        return state["player"].get("body_variant") == token.split(".", 2)[2]
    if token.startswith("counter."):
        return _to_int(state["counters"].get(token[8:], 0), 0)
    if token.startswith("streak."):
        return _to_int(state["streaks"].get(token[7:], 0), 0)
    if token.startswith("upgrade."):
        return _to_int(state["upgrades"].get(token[8:], 0), 0)
    if token.startswith("item."):
        return _to_int(state["items"].get(token[5:], 0), 0)
    if token.startswith("product."):
        return _to_int(state["products"].get(token[8:], 0), 0)
    if token.startswith("food."):
        return _to_int(state["food"].get(token[5:], 0), 0)
    if token.startswith("habitat."):
        sub = token[8:]
        if sub.endswith("_level"):
            hab_name = sub[:-6]
            return _to_int((state["habitats"].get(hab_name) or {}).get("level", 0), 0)
        return _to_int((state["habitats"].get(sub) or {}).get("used", 0), 0)
    if token.startswith("herd."):
        return _to_int(state["herd"].get(token[5:], 0), 0)
    if token.startswith("ecology."):
        return _to_int(state["ecology"].get(token[8:], 0), 0)
    if token.startswith("farm."):
        return _to_int(state["farm"].get(token[5:], 0), 0)
    if token.startswith("reputation."):
        return _to_int(state["reputation"].get(token[11:], 0), 0)
    if token == "trust":
        return _to_int(resident["trust"], 0) if resident else _to_int(state["herd"]["trust"], 0)
    if token == "morale":
        return _to_int(resident["morale"], 0) if resident else _to_int(state["herd"]["morale"], 0)
    if token == "fatigue":
        return _to_int(resident["fatigue"], 0) if resident else _to_int(state["herd"]["fatigue"], 0)
    if token == "active_path":
        if resident:
            return resident.get("active_path", "")
        for r in state["residents"].values():
            if r.get("active_path"):
                return r["active_path"]
        return ""
    if token == "active_threat_path":
        for th in state["active_threats"].values():
            if th.get("active_path"):
                return th["active_path"]
        return ""
    if token == "day":
        return state["day"]
    if token == "season":
        return state["season"]
    if token == "weather":
        return state["weather"]
    if token in ("moon", "moon_phase"):
        return state["moon_phase"]
    if token == "funds":
        return state["funds"]
    if token == "debt":
        return state["debt"]
    if token == "days_captive":
        return _to_int(state["player"].get("days_captive", 0), 0)
    if token.startswith("days_"):
        dc = state["player"].get("day_counters") or {}
        if token in dc:
            return _to_int(dc[token], 0)
        return _to_int(state["counters"].get(token, 0), 0)
    return state["flags"].get(token, False)


def _parse_literal(raw):
    s = raw.strip()
    if s in ("true", "True"):
        return True
    if s in ("false", "False"):
        return False
    if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?", s):
        return float(s) if "." in s else int(s)
    if (s.startswith('"') and s.endswith('"')) or (s.startswith("'") and s.endswith("'")):
        return s[1:-1]
    return s


def _split_top_level(expr, seps):
    parts = []
    buf = []
    depth = 0
    in_sq = 0
    i = 0
    n = len(expr)
    while i < n:
        ch = expr[i]
        if ch == "(":
            depth += 1
        elif ch == ")" and depth > 0:
            depth -= 1
        elif ch == "[":
            in_sq += 1
        elif ch == "]" and in_sq > 0:
            in_sq -= 1
        if depth == 0 and in_sq == 0:
            matched = None
            for sep in seps:
                if expr.startswith(sep, i):
                    matched = sep
                    break
            if matched:
                parts.append("".join(buf).strip())
                buf = []
                i += len(matched)
                continue
        buf.append(ch)
        i += 1
    tail = "".join(buf).strip()
    if tail:
        parts.append(tail)
    return parts


def _strip_outer_parens(expr):
    s = expr.strip()
    while s.startswith("(") and s.endswith(")"):
        depth = 0
        balanced = True
        for idx, ch in enumerate(s):
            if ch == "(":
                depth += 1
            elif ch == ")":
                depth -= 1
                if depth == 0 and idx < len(s) - 1:
                    balanced = False
                    break
        if balanced and depth == 0:
            s = s[1:-1].strip()
        else:
            break
    return s


def eval_gate_expr(state, expr, resident=None):
    s = _strip_outer_parens(str(expr or "").strip())
    if not s:
        return True, []

    or_parts = _split_top_level(s, ("||",))
    if len(or_parts) > 1:
        all_missing = []
        for part in or_parts:
            ok, missing = eval_gate_expr(state, part, resident)
            if ok:
                return True, []
            all_missing.extend(missing)
        return False, [f"({s})"]

    and_parts = _split_top_level(s, (",", "&&"))
    if len(and_parts) > 1:
        missing_all = []
        for part in and_parts:
            ok, missing = eval_gate_expr(state, part, resident)
            if not ok:
                missing_all.extend(missing)
        return len(missing_all) == 0, missing_all

    m_in = re.match(r"^(.+?)\s+in\s+\[(.+)\]$", s)
    if m_in:
        lhs = _resolve_var(state, m_in.group(1), resident)
        choices = [_parse_literal(x) for x in m_in.group(2).split(",")]
        ok = lhs in choices
        return ok, [] if ok else [f"{s} (got {lhs})"]

    m_cmp = re.match(r"^(.+?)\s*(>=|<=|==|!=|>|<)\s*(.+)$", s)
    if m_cmp:
        lhs_raw, op, rhs_raw = m_cmp.group(1), m_cmp.group(2), m_cmp.group(3)
        lhs = _resolve_var(state, lhs_raw, resident)
        rhs = _parse_literal(rhs_raw)
        ok = False
        if op == "==":
            ok = lhs == rhs
        elif op == "!=":
            ok = lhs != rhs
        else:
            lnum = _to_float(lhs, 0.0)
            rnum = _to_float(rhs, 0.0)
            if op == ">=":
                ok = lnum >= rnum
            elif op == "<=":
                ok = lnum <= rnum
            elif op == ">":
                ok = lnum > rnum
            elif op == "<":
                ok = lnum < rnum
        return ok, [] if ok else [f"{s} (got {lhs})"]

    val = _resolve_var(state, s, resident)
    ok = bool(val)
    return ok, [] if ok else [s]


def _apply_fx(state, fx, stage=None):
    applied = []
    if not isinstance(fx, dict):
        return applied
    stage_num = 0
    if stage in ("S1", "S2", "S3"):
        stage_num = int(stage[1])
    for tr in fx.get("traits") or []:
        t_stage = tr.get("stage")
        if t_stage is None or stage is None or t_stage == stage:
            name = tr["name"]
            state["player"]["traits"][name] = True
            applied.append(f"player.trait:{name}")
    for st in fx.get("statuses") or []:
        state["player"]["statuses"][st] = True
        applied.append(f"player.status:{st}")
    for tf in fx.get("tfs") or []:
        sp = tf["species"]
        target_lvl = stage_num if stage_num > 0 else tf.get("maxStage", 1)
        prev = _to_int(state["player"]["tf"].get(sp, 0), 0)
        if target_lvl > prev:
            state["player"]["tf"][sp] = min(tf.get("maxStage", 3), target_lvl)
            applied.append(f"player.tf:{sp}={state['player']['tf'][sp]}")
    for cr in fx.get("cravings") or []:
        cid = cr["id"]
        target_lvl = stage_num if stage_num > 0 else cr.get("maxStage", 1)
        prev = _to_int(state["player"]["cravings"].get(cid, 0), 0)
        if target_lvl > prev:
            state["player"]["cravings"][cid] = min(cr.get("maxStage", 3), target_lvl)
            applied.append(f"player.craving:{cid}={state['player']['cravings'][cid]}")
    for fl in fx.get("flags") or []:
        state["flags"][fl] = True
        applied.append(f"flag:{fl}")
    return applied


def _evaluate_target(state, target_id, resident=None, stage=None):
    tid = target_id.strip()
    if tid in PATHS:
        p = PATHS[tid]
        if p["stages"]:
            st = stage or "S1"
            if st not in p["stages"]:
                return False, [f"Invalid stage {st} for {tid}"], p, st
            ok, missing = eval_gate_expr(state, p["stages"][st], resident)
            return ok, missing, p, st
        ok, missing = eval_gate_expr(state, p["gate"], resident)
        return ok, missing, p, ""
    if tid in TWISTS:
        tw = TWISTS[tid]
        ok, missing = eval_gate_expr(state, tw["gate"], resident)
        return ok, missing, tw, "TWIST"
    if tid in PONRS:
        pn = PONRS[tid]
        ok, missing = eval_gate_expr(state, pn["gate"], resident)
        return ok, missing, pn, "PONR"
    if tid in BAD_ENDINGS:
        be = BAD_ENDINGS[tid]
        missing = []
        if be["warning_flag"] and not state["flags"].get(be["warning_flag"]):
            w_ok, w_miss = eval_gate_expr(state, be["warning_gate"], resident)
            if not w_ok:
                missing.append(f"Warning Gate not reached ({', '.join(w_miss)})")
            else:
                missing.append(f"Warning window active (flag:{be['warning_flag']} must fire first)")
        ok, m2 = eval_gate_expr(state, be["gate"], resident)
        if not ok:
            missing.extend(m2)
        return len(missing) == 0, missing, be, "BAD_ENDING"
    return False, [f"Unknown path/special id: {tid}"], None, ""


def _advance_day(state, days=1, weather=None, moon_phase=None):
    notes = []
    for _ in range(max(1, _to_int(days, 1))):
        state["day"] += 1
        cur_moon_idx = MOONS.index(state["moon_phase"]) if state["moon_phase"] in MOONS else 1
        state["moon_phase"] = MOONS[(cur_moon_idx + 1) % len(MOONS)]
        if state["day"] % 15 == 1 and state["day"] > 1:
            cur_s_idx = SEASONS.index(state["season"]) if state["season"] in SEASONS else 0
            state["season"] = SEASONS[(cur_s_idx + 1) % len(SEASONS)]

        # Increment captivity / status day counters
        if any(k.startswith("captive_") and v for k, v in state["player"]["statuses"].items()):
            state["player"]["days_captive"] = _to_int(state["player"].get("days_captive", 0), 0) + 1
        for st_key, st_val in state["player"]["statuses"].items():
            if st_val and st_key.startswith("captive_"):
                dc_key = f"days_{st_key}"
                state["player"]["day_counters"][dc_key] = _to_int(state["player"]["day_counters"].get(dc_key, 0), 0) + 1

        # Daily feed consumption & resident recovery
        res_count = len(state["residents"])
        if state["food"].get("general_feed", 0) >= res_count:
            state["food"]["general_feed"] -= res_count
        else:
            short = res_count - state["food"].get("general_feed", 0)
            state["food"]["general_feed"] = 0
            state["debt"] += short * 5
            notes.append(f"Feed shortfall (+{short * 5}g debt)")

        for res in state["residents"].values():
            res["fatigue"] = _clamp(res.get("fatigue", 12) - 4)
            if res.get("task"):
                res["trust"] = _clamp(res.get("trust", 30) + 1)
                res["morale"] = _clamp(res.get("morale", 50) + 1)
        _recompute_herd(state)

        # Check Bad Ending Warning Gates automatically
        for be in BAD_ENDINGS.values():
            if be["warning_flag"] and not state["flags"].get(be["warning_flag"]):
                w_ok, _ = eval_gate_expr(state, be["warning_gate"])
                if w_ok:
                    state["flags"][be["warning_flag"]] = True
                    notes.append(f"WARNING GATE: {be['title']} (flag:{be['warning_flag']} triggered)")

    if weather:
        state["weather"] = str(weather).strip()
    if moon_phase:
        state["moon_phase"] = str(moon_phase).strip()
    tier = _debt_tier(state["debt"])
    if tier:
        notes.append(tier)
    return notes

            en = en.strip().lower() in ("1", "true", "yes", "on")
        if not tr:

            state["player"]["traits"][tr] = True
        else:
            state["player"]["traits"].pop(tr, None)
        msg = f"player.trait:{tr} = {bool(en)}."

    elif act == "set_player_state":
        kind = _slug(args.get("kind") or "status")
        key = _slug(args.get("key") or args.get("name"))
        val = args.get("value")
        en = args.get("enabled", True)

                state["player"]["statuses"][key] = True
            else:
                state["player"]["statuses"].pop(key, None)
            msg = f"player.status:{key} = {bool(en)}."
        elif kind == "tf":
            sp = _canon_species(key)
            lvl = max(0, min(3, _to_int(val, 1)))
            if lvl == 0:
                state["player"]["tf"].pop(sp, None)
            else:
                state["player"]["tf"][sp] = lvl
            msg = f"player.tf:{sp} = {lvl}."

            lvl = max(0, min(3, _to_int(val, 1)))
            if lvl == 0:
                state["player"]["cravings"].pop(key, None)
            else:
                state["player"]["cravings"][key] = lvl
            msg = f"player.craving:{key} = {lvl}."
        else:
            return state, {"ok": False, "error": f"Unknown player state kind: {kind}"}, False

    elif act == "evaluate_gates":
        tid = str(args.get("target_id") or "").strip()
        res = _find_resident(state, args.get("resident")) if args.get("resident") else None
        stage = str(args.get("stage") or "").strip().upper() or None
        passed, missing, obj, resolved_stage = _evaluate_target(state, tid, res, stage)
        return state, {
            "ok": True,
            "target_id": tid,
            "passed": passed,
            "missing": missing,
            "stage": resolved_stage,
            "title": obj["title"] if obj else "",
        }, True

    elif act == "set_active_path":
        tid = str(args.get("target_id") or "").strip()
        res = _find_resident(state, args.get("resident")) if args.get("resident") else None
        stage = str(args.get("stage") or "").strip().upper() or None
        force = bool(args.get("force", False))

        passed, missing, obj, resolved_stage = _evaluate_target(state, tid, res, stage)
        if not obj:
            return state, {"ok": False, "error": missing[0] if missing else "Unknown path"}, False

        if not passed and not force:
            return state, {
                "ok": False,
                "blocked": True,
                "target_id": tid,
                "missing": missing,
                "error": f"Gate(s) unmet for {tid}: {'; '.join(missing)}",
            }, False

        applied = []
        if tid in PATHS:
            if obj["is_threat"]:
                th_id = obj["species"]
                state["active_threats"][th_id] = {
                    "species": th_id,
                    "active_path": tid,
                    "stage": resolved_stage,
                }
            else:
                if res is None:
                    # Match first resident of same species if omitted
                    for r in state["residents"].values():
                        if r["species"] == obj["species"]:
                            res = r
                            break
                if res is not None:
                    res["active_path"] = tid
                    res["path_stage"] = resolved_stage
                    res["paused"] = False
            applied = _apply_fx(state, obj.get("fx"), resolved_stage or None)
            msg = f"Activated path '{tid}'" + (f" ({resolved_stage})" if resolved_stage else "") + (f" [FORCED]" if force and not passed else "") + "."
        elif tid in TWISTS:
            if tid not in state["triggered_twists"]:
                state["triggered_twists"].append(tid)

        elif tid in BAD_ENDINGS:

    elif act == "manage_resident":
        op = _slug(args.get("op") or "update")

            rid = _slug(rname)

        elif op == "remove":

            else:

                    res["morale"] = _clamp(res["morale"] + _to_int(args["morale_delta"], 0))
                if args.get("fatigue_delta") is not None:

                if args.get("body_variant") is not None:

                msg = f"Updated {res['name']}."

    elif act == "economy_tx":
        op = _slug(args.get("op") or "buy")
        target = _slug(args.get("target"))
        amt = max(1, _to_int(args.get("amount"), 1))
        price = _to_int(args.get("unit_price"), PRODUCT_PRICES.get(target, 15))
        cat = _slug(args.get("category") or "item")

        if op == "buy":
            gross = amt * price
            if state["funds"] < gross:

                state["debt"] += short
            else:
                state["funds"] -= gross
            if cat == "food" or target in ("general_feed", "fresh_greens", "meat"):

                state["food"][k] = state["food"].get(k, 0) + amt
            else:

            msg = f"Bought {amt}x {target} for {gross}g (Funds: {state['funds']}g, Debt: {state['debt']}g)."

            state["products"][target] = have - amt
            state["funds"] += net
            msg = f"Sold {amt}x {target} for {gross}g (-{fee}g Corvin Vale 5% cut = +{net}g net)."

        elif op == "upgrade":

            msg = f"Built/upgraded {target} (Lv.{state['upgrades'][target]}) for {cost}g."

        elif op == "adjust":
            delta = _to_int(args.get("amount"), 0)
            if target == "debt":

            elif target in state["products"] or cat == "product":
                state["products"][target] = max(0, state["products"].get(target, 0) + delta)
            else:
                state["funds"] = max(0, state["funds"] + delta)
            msg = f"Adjusted {target} by {delta}."

    elif act == "farm_action":
        op = _slug(args.get("op"))
        target = str(args.get("target") or "").strip()
        if op == "policy":
            rt = _slug(target)
            if rt not in FARM_ROUTES:
                return state, {"ok": False, "error": f"Unknown policy route: {rt}"}, False
            state["policy"] = rt
            msg = f"Farm policy set to '{rt}'."
        elif op == "safeword":
            res = _find_resident(state, target) if target else None
            if res and res.get("active_path") in PATHS and PATHS[res["active_path"]]["is_threat"]:
                return state, {"ok": False, "error": "Safeword denied: Wild Threat routes have no safety net or consent framework."}, False
            if state["active_threats"] and not res:
                return state, {"ok": False, "error": "Safeword denied on active Wild Threat route."}, False
            if res:

                msg = f"Safeword invoked with {res['name']}; scene paused cleanly with no penalty."
            else:
                for r in state["residents"].values():
                    if r.get("active_path"):

        elif op == "purify":
            sp = _canon_species(target)
            lvl = _to_int(state["player"]["tf"].get(sp, 0), 0)
            if lvl <= 0:
                return state, {"ok": False, "error": f"No active TF for {sp}."}, False
            if lvl >= 3 and not state["flags"].get("unicorn_purge_available") and not args.get("force"):
                return state, {"ok": False, "error": "Stage-3 TF is permanent unless reversed via Unicorn Purge ('flag:unicorn_purge_available')."}, False
            state["player"]["tf"].pop(sp, None)

        elif op == "quest_complete":

            found["status"] = "completed"
            if found.get("reward_flag"):

            msg = f"Quest '{found['title']}' completed!" + (f" Set 'flag:{found['reward_flag']}'." if found.get("reward_flag") else "")
        elif op == "quest_add":

        elif op == "contain":

    elif act == "end_day":
        notes = _advance_day(state, args.get("days", 1), args.get("weather"), args.get("moon_phase"))
        msg = f"Advanced to Day {state['day']} ({state['season']}, {state['weather']}, Moon: {state['moon_phase']})."

    elif act == "feed_request":
        predator = str(args.get("predator") or "").strip()
        target = str(args.get("target") or "").strip()
        if not predator or not target:
            return state, {"ok": False, "error": "feed_request requires both predator and target."}, False
        state["pending_feed"] = {"predator": predator, "target": target}

        if not confirm:

        elif view == "residents":
            msg = "Residents: " + "; ".join(f"{r['name']} ({r['species']}, Trust {r['trust']}, Morale {r['morale']}, Fatigue {r['fatigue']}, Task: {r['task'] or 'none'}, Path: {r['active_path'] or 'none'})" for r in state["residents"].values())
        elif view == "quests":

        else:

    else:
        return state, {"ok": False, "error": f"Unknown action: {action}"}, False

    state["last_ledger_note"] = msg
    result = {"ok": ok, "action": act, "message": msg}
    result.update(extra)
    return state, result, False


def _parse_slash_or_prefix(cmd_obj, user_msg):
    if isinstance(cmd_obj, dict) and cmd_obj.get("subcommand") is not None:
        sub = _slug(cmd_obj.get("subcommand"))
        raw = str(cmd_obj.get("rawArgs") or "").strip()
        return sub, raw, False

    for line in str(user_msg or "").splitlines():
        s = line.strip()
        if not s.startswith("/"):
            continue
        low = s.lower()
        if low.startswith("/confirm feed"):
            return "confirm_feed", "", False
        if low == "/cancel":
            return "cancel", "", False
        if low == "/nextday":
            return "endday", "", False
        m = re.match(r"^/([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*)(?:\s+(.*))?$", s)
        if m:
            return _slug(m.group(1)), (m.group(2) or "").strip(), False
    return "", "", False


def _dispatch_text_command(state, sub, raw):
    is_meta = sub in META_COMMANDS
    tokens = raw.split() if raw else []
    force = "--force" in tokens
    tokens = [t for t in tokens if t != "--force"]

    if sub in ("farm", "ledger") and not raw:
        return _apply_action(state, "get_status", {"view": "ledger"})
    if sub == "farm" and tokens:
        sub = _slug(tokens[0])
        tokens = tokens[1:]
        raw = " ".join(tokens)
        is_meta = sub in META_COMMANDS

    if sub == "help":
        return state, {"ok": True, "message": "Commands: /farm, /ledger, /market [topic], /residents, /quests, /policy [route], /assign [res] to [task], /buy [item], /sell [product] [amt], /upgrade [name], /endday, /bond|/date|/care [res], /path [res] [path_id] [S1|S2|S3], /feed [predator] with [target], /confirm feed, /cancel | Plumbing: !farm flag|counter|streak|trait|status|tf|craving|gates|safeword|purify"}, False
    if sub == "reset":
        fresh = init_state({})
        return fresh, {"ok": True, "message": "Reset farm state to Day 1."}, False
    if sub in ("ledger", "market", "residents", "quests"):
        return _apply_action(state, "get_status", {"view": sub, "topic": tokens[0] if tokens else ""})
    if sub in ("endday", "nextday", "end_day"):
        return _apply_action(state, "end_day", {})
    if sub == "policy":
        return _apply_action(state, "farm_action", {"op": "policy", "target": tokens[0] if tokens else ""})
    if sub == "assign":
        m = re.match(r"^(.+?)\s+to\s+(.+)$", raw, re.I)
        if m:
            return _apply_action(state, "manage_resident", {"op": "assign", "resident": m.group(1), "task": m.group(2)})
        return state, {"ok": False, "error": "Usage: /assign <resident> to <task>"}, False
    if sub == "buy":
        amt = _to_int(tokens[1], 1) if len(tokens) > 1 and tokens[1].isdigit() else 1
        return _apply_action(state, "economy_tx", {"op": "buy", "target": tokens[0] if tokens else "", "amount": amt})
    if sub == "sell":
        amt = _to_int(tokens[1], 1) if len(tokens) > 1 else 1
        return _apply_action(state, "economy_tx", {"op": "sell", "target": tokens[0] if tokens else "", "amount": amt})
    if sub == "upgrade":
        return _apply_action(state, "economy_tx", {"op": "upgrade", "target": tokens[0] if tokens else ""})
    if sub in ("bond", "date", "care"):
        return _apply_action(state, "manage_resident", {"op": sub, "resident": tokens[0] if tokens else ""})
    if sub == "hunt":
        return _apply_action(state, "farm_action", {"op": "hunt", "target": raw})
    if sub == "contain":
        return _apply_action(state, "farm_action", {"op": "contain", "target": raw})
    if sub == "event":
        if tokens and _slug(tokens[0]) == "complete" and len(tokens) > 1:
            return _apply_action(state, "farm_action", {"op": "quest_complete", "target": tokens[1]})
        return _apply_action(state, "farm_action", {"op": "quest_add", "target": raw or "Farm Event"})
    if sub == "feed":
        m = re.match(r"^(.+?)\s+with\s+(.+)$", raw, re.I)
        if m:
            return _apply_action(state, "feed_request", {"predator": m.group(1), "target": m.group(2)})
        return state, {"ok": False, "error": "Usage: /feed <predator> with <target>"}, False
    if sub in ("confirm_feed", "confirm-feed"):
        return _apply_action(state, "confirm_feed", {"confirm": True})
    if sub == "cancel":
        return _apply_action(state, "confirm_feed", {"confirm": False})
    if sub == "safeword":
        return _apply_action(state, "farm_action", {"op": "safeword", "target": raw})
    if sub == "purify":
        return _apply_action(state, "farm_action", {"op": "purify", "target": raw, "force": force})
    if sub == "path":
        if len(tokens) == 1:
            res = _find_resident(state, tokens[0])
            if res:
                return state, {"ok": True, "message": f"{res['name']} active_path={res.get('active_path') or 'none'} ({res.get('path_stage') or '-'})"}, False
            return _apply_action(state, "set_active_path", {"target_id": tokens[0], "force": force})
        if len(tokens) >= 2:
            if tokens[0] in PATHS or tokens[0] in TWISTS or tokens[0] in PONRS or tokens[0] in BAD_ENDINGS:
                st = tokens[1].upper() if tokens[1].upper() in ("S1", "S2", "S3") else ""
                return _apply_action(state, "set_active_path", {"target_id": tokens[0], "stage": st, "force": force})
            st = tokens[2].upper() if len(tokens) >= 3 and tokens[2].upper() in ("S1", "S2", "S3") else ""
            return _apply_action(state, "set_active_path", {"resident": tokens[0], "target_id": tokens[1], "stage": st, "force": force})
    if sub == "flag":
        val = tokens[1] if len(tokens) > 1 else True
        s, r, _ = _apply_action(state, "set_flag", {"flag": tokens[0] if tokens else "", "value": val})
        return s, r, is_meta
    if sub in ("counter", "streak"):
        delta = _to_int(tokens[1], 1) if len(tokens) > 1 else 1
        s, r, _ = _apply_action(state, "adjust_counter", {"kind": sub, "name": tokens[0] if tokens else "", "delta": delta})
        return s, r, is_meta
    if sub == "trait":
        en = tokens[1].lower() not in ("false", "0", "off") if len(tokens) > 1 else True
        s, r, _ = _apply_action(state, "set_player_trait", {"trait": tokens[0] if tokens else "", "enabled": en})
        return s, r, is_meta
    if sub in ("status", "tf", "craving"):
        key = tokens[0] if tokens else ""
        val = tokens[1] if len(tokens) > 1 else 1
        en = str(val).lower() not in ("false", "0", "off")
        s, r, _ = _apply_action(state, "set_player_state", {"kind": sub, "key": key, "value": val, "enabled": en})
        return s, r, is_meta
    if sub == "gates":
        tid = tokens[0] if tokens else ""
        st = tokens[1].upper() if len(tokens) > 1 and tokens[1].upper() in ("S1", "S2", "S3") else ""
        s, r, _ = _apply_action(state, "evaluate_gates", {"target_id": tid, "stage": st})
        return s, r, is_meta
    return state, {"ok": False, "error": f"Unknown command: {sub}"}, False


def on_before_generate(state, ctx):
    state = ensure_state_shape(state)
    ctx = ctx or {}
    sub, raw, _ = _parse_slash_or_prefix(ctx.get("command"), ctx.get("userMessage"))
    if not sub:
        return {"state": state}
    next_state, res, strip_cmd = _dispatch_text_command(state, sub, raw)
    msg = res.get("message") or res.get("error") or ""
    if not res.get("ok") and res.get("missing"):
        msg = f"BLOCKED: {msg}"
    return {
        "state": next_state,
        "prompt_injection": f"[COMMAND:{sub}] {msg}",
        "strip_command": bool(strip_cmd),
    }


def on_tool_call(state, call, ctx):
    state = ensure_state_shape(state)
    call = call or {}
    next_state, res, _ = _apply_action(state, call.get("action"), call.get("args"))
    return {"state": next_state, "tool_result": res}


def on_after_generate(state, ctx):
    return {"state": ensure_state_shape(state)}

    for sp, lv in pl["tf"].items():
        if lv:
            pl_pills.append(f"tf:{sp}={lv}")
    for cr, lv in pl["cravings"].items():
        if lv:
            pl_pills.append(f"craving:{cr}={lv}")
    if pl_pills:
        lines.append("Player: " + ", ".join(pl_pills) + " ((PILLS))")

    warns = []
    tier = _debt_tier(s["debt"])
    if tier:
        warns.append(tier)
    if s.get("pending_feed"):
        pf = s["pending_feed"]
        warns.append(f"PENDING FEED: {pf['target']} -> {pf['predator']} (/confirm feed or /cancel)")
    for be in BAD_ENDINGS.values():
        wf = be.get("warning_flag")
        if wf and s["flags"].get(wf):
            warns.append(f"WARNING: {be['title']} ({wf})")
    if s["bad_endings"]:
        warns.append("BAD ENDINGS: " + ", ".join(s["bad_endings"]))
    if warns:
        lines.append("Alerts: " + " | ".join(warns) + " ((PILLS))")
    return "\n".join(lines)
